Test fixtures — broll-engine
============================

All files in this directory are generated programmatically
from pure mathematics / solid colours.

They carry NO copyright (CC0 / public domain).

sample_audio.wav   — 2s 440 Hz sine wave (16-bit PCM, 16 kHz, mono)
clip_city.jpg      — 8x8 steel-blue JPEG
clip_nature.jpg    — 8x8 forest-green JPEG
clip_abstract.jpg  — 8x8 violet JPEG
